description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'CandidateDaoTest' for testing the 'CandidateDao' data access object within the Recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup, various CRUD tests, filtering, and history tracking related to Candidate and CandidateVacancy entities.

classes.name: CandidateDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test suite for testing candidate-related data access functionality within the recruitment module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the CandidateDao instance and populates test data from YAML fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testSaveCandidate
methods.description: Tests saving a new Candidate entity to the database and verifies associated properties.

methods.name: testSaveCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Tests saving a CandidateVacancy association and verifies linked entities.

methods.name: testGetCandidateById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Candidate by ID, including cases where ID does not exist.

methods.name: testGetCandidateVacancyByCandidateId
methods.description: Tests retrieving CandidateVacancy record by candidate ID.

methods.name: testDeleteCandidates
methods.description: Tests deletion of Candidates by ID array.

methods.name: testDeleteCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Tests deletion of CandidateVacancy by candidate ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateList
methods.description: Retrieves list of candidates and verifies default filtering.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByCandidateId
methods.description: Filters candidate list by candidate ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByVacancyId
methods.description: Filters candidate list by vacancy ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByJobTitleId
methods.description: Filters candidate list by job title ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByHiringMangerId
methods.description: Filters candidate list by hiring manager ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByStatus
methods.description: Filters candidate list by application status.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByMethodOfApplication
methods.description: Filters candidate list by method of application.

methods.name: testSaveCandidateHistory
methods.description: Tests saving a CandidateHistory record associated with a candidate vacancy.
